correctness.rationale: The 27 exceptional-line classes and anticanonical triple test define all 45 vertices. Exact integer incidence verifies parameters (45,12,3,3), yielding spectrum 0,9,15 for the Laplacian and 3^62*5^23 spanning trees. Source-based second adjacency matrix passes the same graph checks. Exact Bareiss determinants and independent local Smith arithmetic are replayed for three reduced Laplacians per graph: cubic p3 valuation counts (0:15,1:10,2:5,3:14), p5 (0:21,1:23); second graph p3 (0:17,1:8,2:3,3:16), p5 identical. Valuation sums equal determinant exponents, so all invariant factors are exhausted; the resulting two groups differ in p3 generator rank. All claimed finite enumerations are exhaustive by explicit loops and reproduce with standard Python only.

evidence: Coolsaet–Degraer–Spence (2006), DOI 10.37236/1058, classifies 78 isomorphism types with parameters (45,12,3,3).
Biggs (1999), Chip-Firing and the Critical Group of a Graph, proves general results about subgroup structure in strongly regular graphs, rather than the full 45-vertex Smith decomposition.
The shared spectrum forces exactly 3^62 5^23 spanning trees but not the Smith factors, as the verified counterexample demonstrates.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The graph classification and general spectral identities cover isomorphism classes, adjacency eigenvalues and tree counts. They do not determine the integral p-primary decompositions: the two explicit source graphs have the same parameters and different 3-primary ranks. General chip-firing results do not imply these four entire valuation multiplicity distributions.

value.rationale: The 45 tritangent planes form a canonical geometric incidence configuration on any smooth cubic surface, so the full integral graph Jacobian is a motivated invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Its exact 3-primary structure discriminates it from a same-order, same-degree, same-intersection-parameter and cospectral graph, showing concretely why the known 2006 spectral classification and spanning-tree count cannot supply this integral datum. The complete invariant-factor answer and explicit witness are reusable for comparisons of arithmetic graph Jacobians and cubic-surface incidence objects.
